title: Connected-account jobs finish and get filed after the user leaves the page
gap: Only the route's 'status' action and the planner call pollConsumerGeneration (lib/higgsfield-consumer/generation-service.ts:261). app/api/cron/sync/route.ts has no stage for consumer jobs. Gen (use-composer.ts:510-541), Business (use-connected-job.ts:52-67) and Viral (use-viral.ts:86-94) poll only from component state. If the user switches tab, reloads or leaves mid-render, the paid original is never collected into Takes, and Viral rows stay 'accepted' indefinitely.
target: Add stage('connected_jobs') to the cron sync workspace loop. It selects higgsfield_consumer_jobs rows in accepted/uncertain status (bounded count, uses deadlineAt) and calls the existing pollConsumerGeneration / pollConsumerGenjutsu / pollConsumerMarketingVideo with each row's user_id. Move the draft-filing logic out of use-composer's 'filed' effect into a server lib function the poller calls on completion. On mount, each composer lists its GET jobs and resumes polling any non-terminal job it finds.
respects_rules: Extends the existing lib poll functions and the existing cron route. It only polls and never resubmits, so nothing can be charged twice.
